subject: Compile-time arithmetic expressions
notes: kb/Work PB1369 re-verdict (w20261759a), cite.py --check 7.3.6.2 -> OK 7.3.6.2 2). Both halves hold on this build. Precision/magnitude: DOC-A.1-29 documents 28-29 digits / 7.9E28 at 2023 and the 34-digit standard-decimal range at 2002/2014; 1234567890123456789012345678901 + 0 and 9999999999999999999999999999 * 10 are refused at 2023 as COBOL1547 citing 'the documented 7.3.6.2 SR2 implementor limit' (no longer SR1b), a directive operand as COBOL1619 with the same text, and both evaluate at 2014 (99999999999999999999999999990). Rounding: documented as nearest-even at 2023 (1.5E-27/2*1E28 = 8) and nearest-away-from-zero at 2002/2014 (= 7), and the evaluator produces exactly those values (CompileTimeArithmeticModeTests.ModeDependentValues_FollowTheEditionsMode, StandardArithmetic_RoundsATieAwayFromZero).
